name: find_kural
description: Find which Thirukkural a Tamil quote comes from, even if it is partial, misspelt or differently spaced. Returns ranked candidates with the canonical text. Use this before quoting any kural.

quote.description: A Tamil quote of any quality: partial, misspelt, spaced or punctuated differently, one line or two.

limit.description: How many candidates to return, 1 to 20.

name: get_kural
description: Get one Thirukkural by number (1 to 1330): canonical Tamil text, chapter, transliteration, citation, public-domain translations and a Merkle proof of the text.

layers.description: Translation or commentary configs to include.

name: verify_quote
description: Check a Tamil quote of a kural against the canonical text. Says whether it is exact, differs only in spacing or punctuation, is a known variant reading, or is a misquote, and lists the words that differ. Use it on any kural a model wrote.

quote.description: The Tamil text to check, exactly as the user or a model wrote it.

number.description: The kural it claims to be, 1 to 1330. Omit to let the tool find it.

name: search_english
description: Find kurals by English keywords in the Pope (1886) and Drew/Lazarus translations. Returns the canonical Tamil text of each match.

query.description: English words to look for in the public-domain translations, e.g. 'friendship adversity'.

limit.description: How many kurals to return, 1 to 20.
